title: feat: allow murderszn to publish community agents
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds @murderszn to the community publisher allowlist for public Cerberus agent publishing.
- Keeps this access change separate from the Jev agent implementation.

Fixes #16165

gist.headline: Another key to the garden
gist.blurb: @murderszn gets a key to publish public Cerberus agents. The Jev agent stays a separate project; one gate at a time.
gist.summary: Adds @murderszn to the community publisher allowlist for public Cerberus agents, independently of the Jev agent implementation.
gist.impact: @murderszn gains permission to publish public Cerberus agents without changing the Jev agent.
gist.visual_concept: Depict @murderszn's new publishing permission as a small key opening a garden gate to a gallery of agent cards. Polli hands over the key; a friendly three-headed dog emblem on the gate suggests Cerberus without implying a new agent has been built.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden, Polli hands a tiny key to a sign marked '@murderszn' beside a gate with a friendly three-headed dog emblem and agent cards beyond it. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny gardener's hat and stays small within the scene. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and chunky sprites.
